findings.candidAssessment: All 20 items have one defensible key and all 120 within-item choice pairs are substantively distinct. The bank is repetitive in format: seven agreement items reuse the two-blank/four-combination grid, eight algebra items reuse the unitless-x/domain/Condition stem, and four fraction items reuse the unitless-q/exact-value stem. Q15 directly reuses agreement constructs from Q04, Q10, and Q13. This format saturation is the main quality concern despite varied arithmetic and grammar subskills. Some fraction distractors (notably 57 in Q16 and 34/53 in Q19) are distinct but weakly motivated.
